orgDesign.companyProfile: A proposed compact vertical-software operating model informed by Twyns. The undated company page describes about 25 people; it does not establish current staffing. The 26-FTE scenario here is inferred: 25 team FTE plus one shared leader, not a claim about Twyns employees.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Four durable teams own reusable capabilities within a shared modular product. Human authority roles retain enforcement and remedy decisions. Hosting, specialist assurance and physical field operations are externally provided where contracted; their costs and service capacity are not supplied. No customer-facing or operational AI agents are assumed.

groups.name: Twyns-Informed Product and Service Organization
groups.mission: Deliver accepted public-service outcomes through a shared platform, coherent customer configurations and sustainable operating commitments.

groupDirectHeadcount.description: One proposed shared product/commercial and organizational leader. This is not an additional layer per team.

teams.name: Field and Case Outcomes
teams.description: Own report-to-intervention and case preparation end to end. The same modular product covers reports, assignments, field records, administrative and investigative preparation, evidence and authority communication. Sequence scope by accepted procedure packs; do not run eight independent microservice teams. Track Priority public-space issues resolved on time. Track Field interventions completed with a usable record. Track Defensible decisions completed within service window. Track Transport interventions accepted by the receiving authority. Track Resident contacts ending in an understandable outcome.

teamHeadcount.description: 8 proposed FTE: 1 product/domain lead, 1 designer/analyst, 4 software engineers, 1 quality engineer and 1 enforcement-domain specialist. Roles are a sizing assumption; this is not the reported Twyns organization.
